action: Wide establishing shot of a small bedroom; the colored-shirt mascot lies at the edge of the bed and scrolls with eyes fixed on the phone; shadow silhouette watches from the window-side wall
caption: ONE MORE SCROLL
camera: slow lateral drift, hold on phone light
contact: phone held at the hand; feet/hips grounded on bed

action: The mascot crosses a warm-windowed apartment street while still looking down at the phone; dark shadow grows across the building facade
caption: JUST ONE MINUTE
camera: tracking medium-wide; keep buildings parallaxing subtly

action: Insert shot of calendar days passing; return to the mascot with slumped shoulders and head down
caption: THE DAYS DISAPPEAR
contact: hands lower toward lap; head angle communicates defeat

action: The mascot pauses, looks at the phone, turns it face-down, then rises to a committed stance; shadow starts to recede
caption: RESET TO ZERO
camera: hold, then a restrained push at the moment of choice
contact: phone touches surface before hand releases

action: The mascot opens a notebook and writes one line; phone remains away on the desk and does not float in the hand
caption: START SMALL
camera: medium shot then insert on page and hand
contact: writing hand meets pen/page; phone stays on desk

action: The mascot climbs visible steps; each foot lands on a tread, and torso rises step by step; the shadow becomes smaller
caption: SHOW UP AGAIN
contact: feet land on stair treads, no floating

action: A friend enters from the right; both characters stop, turn toward each other, and exchange a small supportive gesture
caption: YOU ARE NOT ALONE
camera: wide two-shot followed by a restrained reaction close-up
contact: both feet planted; hands remain attached to arms

action: The mascot looks toward the brighter street; the shadow shrinks to a small shape at the edge while warm practical light reveals the path forward
caption: YOUR ATTENTION IS YOUR LIFE
camera: slow pull-back to a balanced wide ending
